ChangeClassification.description: Section 5.1. One change classification, individuated by its detection signature and its response obligation, not by a label.

detection_signature.description: The observable signature that distinguishes this classification.

id.description: The classification handle (drift, coherent_evolution, strategic_pivot, capture).

ChangeClassification.title: ChangeClassification

ConcentrationShift.description: Section 5. A detected concentration shift, classified before any response.

dimensions_implicated.description: Which of the three dimensions the shift implicates.

review_completed.description: Whether the response obligation for the classification was completed.

ConcentrationShift.title: ConcentrationShift

ConformanceAnswer.description: Per-invariant answer; silence is not one of the values.
ConformanceAnswer.title: ConformanceAnswer

ConformanceDeclaration.description: Section 4. The three invariant answers on the face. There is deliberately no overall or total field: conformance is per-invariant, mirroring the suite's refusal to collapse a profile into a single number.
ConformanceDeclaration.title: ConformanceDeclaration

DimensionAssessment.description: Section 4.1. The current-versus-authorized assessment for one dimension.

authorized_level.description: The authorized distribution profile in this dimension.

current_concentration.description: The current distribution profile in this dimension.

gap.description: The gap between current and authorized in this dimension.

DimensionAssessment.title: DimensionAssessment

OverrideClass.description: Section 4.5. One external-override class, a distinct structural mechanism through which an external actor can supersede internal outcomes, individuated by its mechanism and its detection instrument.

detection_instrument.description: The instrument that detects the class.

id.description: The class handle (financial, military, regulatory, platform, epistemic, normative, relational).

mechanism.description: The distinct structural mechanism of the override.

OverrideClass.title: OverrideClass

OverrideClassAssessment.description: Section 4.5. Whether an override class is active in the system's context, with addressability.

active.description: Whether the class is active; a not-active determination requires a named rationale.

addressability.description: Whether the structural condition can still be redesigned before it becomes load-bearing, or can only be disclosed and monitored.

exposure_disclosure.description: A structural exposure disclosure, required for an active class that is no longer addressable.

not_active_rationale.description: Required in prose when active is false, a named rationale rather than a default omission.

OverrideClassAssessment.title: OverrideClassAssessment

PowerDimension.description: Section 2.2, 3. One power dimension, a distinct relational-topological axis individuated by its power concern and its detection surface, not by a label. A dimension with no detection surface cannot be instrumented, so detection_surface is required.

detection_surface.description: Section 6. The primary, secondary, and tertiary signals that instrument the dimension.

independent_by_design.description: Section 2.3. True, because the three dimensions vary independently and are assessed independently.

normative_benchmark.description: The normative reference the dimension is assessed against (for example Ostrom's third principle, subsidiarity, Lukes' three dimensions).

power_concern.description: The distinct structural power concern of the dimension.

PowerDimension.title: PowerDimension

SPOSArchitecture.description: The system-level detection architecture and tier. Higher-tier fields are optional in the schema; the checker requires them at the tiers the register specifies.

detection_disclosed.description: Section 6.4. The detection surface is disclosed to participants; an undisclosed surface is a consent failure.

monitor_all_dimensions.description: Section 4.3. Continuous detection across all three dimensions.

SPOSArchitecture.title: SPOSArchitecture

SPOSPowerRecord.description: A system's power-distribution record across the three dimensions, its override assessment, its detected shifts, and its conformance.

architecture.description: The system's detection architecture and adopted tier.

authorized_profile_established.description: Section 4.1. The authorized distribution profile exists; its absence is itself a finding.

conformance.description: Section 4. The three invariant answers on the face; no total.

detected_shifts.description: Section 5. Concentration shifts detected and classified.

dimensions.description: Section 3, 4.1. The per-dimension assessment (current versus authorized profile and the gap), across all three dimensions.

override_assessment.description: Section 4.5. The assessment of the seven external-override classes, active or not, with addressability.

SPOSPowerRecord.title: SPOSPowerRecord
